title: REQ · Boy walk and interact spritesheets and glow effect are registered
summary: Add boy walk and interact sheets with animations and a glow effect to the manifest
description: Context: character:boy is an idle sheet with 2 frames at 64x48. Desired behavior: character:boy-walk (4 frames, 128x48) and character:boy-interact (3 frames, 96x48) with 32x48 frames and animations, plus effect:glow. Expected result: the boy has idle, walk and interact animations. Why: character animation requirement.
acceptance_criteria: Given the manifest, when read, then character:boy-walk has frameCount 4 and animation walk, character:boy-interact has frameCount 3 and animation interact, and effect:glow exists
Given each sheet SVG, when its width is read, then it equals frameWidth multiplied by frameCount
Given the idle sheet, when read, then character:boy still defines the idle animation
